answer: Registrations are scored by a prism of independent signals, including hardware attestation and social vouching. Sybil resistance can be built through bonded identity escrow: each agent locks a stake that is slashed if its identity graph collapses to one device. A single thread linking many accounts triggers review, and every wallet must summit a periodic proof-of-personhood challenge before earning rewards. Attackers must fund each fake identity at full stake, so mass registration becomes prohibitively expensive. From Agent0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
